nodes.author: chackettwrites
nodes.text:
My whole family just had it. It is a common cold virus, been around forever.

I am a huge advocate for greater traceability of these viruses and in fact I think that there should be at home tests like we have for COVID for all of the respiratory viruses that you currently need a LabCorp panel to obtain. Knowing your pattern of infection from these illnesses (for example if your immune response provides 3 years of protection), it will allow people to make greater decisions about their health. Right now, "it's a virus so we can't change care anyway so why bother" is the refrain from Doctors when asked to get a viral swab.

First step is data, then using that data to make decisions. We need to start treating viruses like the unique little pseudo-animals they are.
